headline: 3 burned in gas explosion at home in Dhaka's Vatara
summary: A gas line leakage caused a blast in the Nutun Bazar 100 Feet Road area, injuring three members of the same family.
details: Three members of the same family were burned in a gas line leakage explosion at a residence in the Nutun Bazar 100 Feet Road area under Vatara police station in Dhaka.
The injured are identified as 24-year-old Md. Shahin, his 21-year-old wife Fahima Akter, and Shahin's 8-year-old niece Hafsa Akter.
Following the incident, the victims were rescued and admitted to the National Institute of Burn and Plastic Surgery Institute for treatment.
caption:
A gas leak explosion in Dhaka's Vatara leaves three family members burned.

Three members of the same family were burned in a gas line leakage explosion at a residence in the Nutun Bazar 100 Feet Road area under Vatara police station in Dhaka.

The injured are identified as 24-year-old Md. Shahin, his 21-year-old wife Fahima Akter, and Shahin's 8-year-old niece Hafsa Akter.

Following the incident, the victims were rescued and admitted to the National Institute of Burn and Plastic Surgery Institute for treatment.

Source: Jamuna TV, Somoy News

headline: Rail link with Rajshahi suspended as RU students block tracks
summary: Students of Rajshahi University have halted train services to the city, causing significant disruptions to travel.
details: Students of Rajshahi University (RU) have blocked the railway tracks, leading to the suspension of rail links with Rajshahi.
// This action was taken as part of a protest, though the specific demands of the students were not detailed in the source provided.
// The blockade has resulted in the suspension of train services, leaving passengers stranded and disrupting travel to and from the city.
// Authorities are working to resolve the situation and restore normal rail operations as soon as possible.
